name: css_animation_frames
description: FRAME SHOWCASE of the CSS animation API, meant to be run with AZ_E2E_SHOT_DIR to produce the montage: #sidebar declares BOTH `-azul-animation-out: flyOutRight 1s` (unmount: slides right through its own edge, narrowing, clipped to its frozen box while the card text has ALREADY reflowed underneath) and `-azul-animation-in: flyInLeft 1s` (remount: slides back in from the left edge). Ticked in exact 0.2s increments with a screenshot each, so the strip shows the whole story. The trailing assert keeps the scenario honest headlessly: all zombies reaped at the end.

html: The card text reflows to the final width immediately - the exit animation only paints the leaving sidebar on top.
css: html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; }
#root { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: row; background: #ffffff; }
#sidebar { width: 160px; height: 100%; background: #2b5fad; color: #ffffff; font-size: 18px; padding: 12px; -azul-animation-out: flyOutRight 1s; -azul-animation-in: flyInLeft 1s; }
#card { flex-grow: 1; height: 100%; background: #c0392b; color: #ffffff; font-size: 20px; padding: 16px; }
